Modern Photography Retrospective
Explore the evolution of modern photography through iconic works from the 20th century. This exhibition features pioneers who revolutionized visual storytelling through experimental techniques and bold compositional choices.
modern, photography, contemporary

Street Art Walking Tour: El Raval
Discover hidden murals and graffiti masterpieces in Barcelona's vibrant El Raval neighborhood. This guided walk explores the intersection of street culture, political expression, and contemporary urban aesthetics.
street, urban, contemporary, political

Surrealist Dreams: Miró and Beyond
Immerse yourself in the fantastical world of Joan Miró and his surrealist contemporaries. This exhibition showcases paintings, sculptures, and installations that challenge perception and embrace the subconscious.
surrealism, painting, sculpture, abstract

Digital Futures: Interactive Installations
Experience cutting-edge digital art installations that blur the boundaries between viewer and artwork. This immersive exhibition invites active participation through motion sensors, VR, and generative algorithms.
digital, installation, interactive, contemporary

Feminist Perspectives: Women in Contemporary Art
A powerful collection highlighting female artists challenging patriarchal narratives through diverse media including painting, video, and performance documentation. This exhibition centers voices historically marginalized in art discourse.
feminist, contemporary, political, mixed-media

Gothic Quarter Hidden Gems
Uncover medieval and Renaissance art treasures tucked away in Gothic Quarter churches and historic buildings. This curated tour reveals lesser-known masterpieces spanning centuries of Catalan artistic tradition.
baroque, renaissance, educational

Emerging Artists Open Studios
Visit working studios of emerging contemporary artists in the Poblenou creative district. Experience works in progress across multiple media including painting, sculpture, and mixed media installations.
contemporary, mixed-media, painting, sculpture

Conceptual Minimalism Showcase
A refined survey of conceptual and minimalist installations exploring reduction, idea-first creation, and spatial tension. Works invite slow contemplation and challenge material assumptions through experimental approaches.
conceptual, minimalism, experimental, installation

Immersive Performance Night
A one-night program of live performance art blending movement, projected light, and audience interaction. Guests experience an immersive journey through layered soundscapes and spatial storytelling.
performance, immersive, interactive, experimental

Eco Nature Light Installations
Outdoor eco-inspired light and sound installations near the waterfront explore organic forms, sustainability themes, and sensory calm. Evening activation creates a reflective public-space experience.
nature, installation, experimental, street

Portrait & Video Futures
Digital portrait reinterpretations merge video loops, layered projections, and painterly algorithms to explore identity and presence. The show bridges classical portrait logic with new-media aesthetics.
portrait, video, digital, mixed-media

Family Art Exploration Workshop
A hands-on family-friendly workshop introducing painting and sculpture basics through playful educational prompts. Facilitators guide multi-age participants in collaborative creative exercises.
family-friendly, educational, painting, sculpture
